verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-9), which aligns with auto-populating bill details for review. However, community commentary directly disputes Brex's AI reliability in production financial workflows (hallucinations, incorrect outputs) and states Brex 'didn't successfully make the AI pivot' compared to competitors like Ramp.
